text: G49's readings 45 to 55, stated while reading A17's instantiate window i532_000 (28 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (45) The order is read from the coded concepts' hours and the posts' words, as C2 counted it: a reply that reports terms made earlier, such as a truce or an agreement, is talk of terms shown at the reply's hour, after the attack it answers, as every INV line is. So a neighbour's post that reports the room's targeting as going on, despite the neighbour's earlier offers of peace, shows the attack first and then the talk, in the post's words. Reading 36 is corrected: neopets-055 is O-H, not J, and its row in A17-inst-spec-4.txt is changed before any row is built. A post that admits the room breached an agreement when it destroyed a neighbour's work is the same case (straya-053 c0048): O-H. J stays for a call and talk of terms made in the same words at once (TheB1G-047, physical_removal-056, ss13-063), and AmericanFlaginPlace-068 stays BOUND, since its coded talk at h+39.00 precedes the first coded act at h+40.41 (reading 5). (46) A post that reports a request made and refused, then proposes force, shows the terms first in its words (planetside-062 c0095): BOUND. (47) A report of a compromise the other room proposed is new terms (redvsblue-051 c0035, drawn): DEAL; a third room's warning that its alliance will defend the target is P17's mutual defence, not terms, and the proposer's request for a truce that follows is terms (sooners-018 c0013, c0014): DEAL. (48) A call to resist a neighbour's work that the reply says stands by truce is the room's attack, as readings 18 and 25 (rocketleague-060 c0470, c0471): O-A, INV; a call against a rival who wants to cover the room's work, with no reply that the rival was there first or holds by terms, stays defence (sonicthehedgehog-047 c0028): NA. (49) A visiting faction's call to join a resistance is a visitor's (rocketbeans-058 c0048): V. (50) A post that tells the target the room will invade and offers help if it relocates is terms backed by a threat in one post (ss13-063 c0087): J. (51) A call to fight back that offers talks over chat as the other course, with no request made, shows only the attack (spacexmasterrace-059 c0074): ONE. (52) The target's report of its own agreement with a third room is not talk of terms between this room and another (serbia-057 c0029), nor is the target's offer of a joint fight against a third party, which is P17's (stevenuniverse-061 c0296), nor a proposal to team up with another room for upkeep with no request made (ripcity-060 c0153): NT. (53) A relayed message from a neighbour asking the room to leave a work is terms held, as reading 31 (stlouis-057 c0021, drawn): INV; the target's envoy invoking its truces with third rooms while demanding that the room move contests terms (rpi-055 c0039): OTHER. (54) Terms first shown in another thread than the first call are by the hours (rit-060 c0067, drawn; stlouisblues-065 c0099): O-H. (55) The target's offer of a truce to a member who agreed to join an attack answers it in the thread (sabres-058 c0076): DEAL; the target's request that the room repay its restraint by dropping a mark that defiles its work answers the attack (survivor-045 c0258, drawn, where c0255 and c0257 name the defiling): DEAL. Also: radiohead-057 and satania-052 O-H by readings 13 and 9; skyrim-047 O-A, INV, since the agreement limits the room's wing over the neighbour's logo; roosterteeth-057 P-G6 and not PO, its answer a truce proposed inside the room; placecanada-058 (drawn), portugal-088 and suomi-047 ONE. Draws in this window: placecanada-058 ONE, poland-045 O-A, redvsblue-051 O-A, rit-060 O-H, stlouis-057 O-A, survivor-045 O-A. A slip to disclose: the second draw's ids were listed with awk printing numbered fields, which the rules forbid; the draw file itself was written by the draw script and is unchanged, and no later command uses awk.

G49's readings 56 to 67, stated while reading A17's instantiate window i532_028 (28 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (56) A neutral question to members whether agreements with the target exist names no terms, unlike a question that asserts an alliance (reading 16), so theitalyplace-060 (drawn), whose answer c0242 is restraint, is NT. (57) A call to go and fix the room's covered work, answered by a reply that the room has an ongoing agreement with what covers it, is the room's attack, as readings 18, 25 and 48 (thailand-058 c0100, c0101): O-A, INV. (58) A neighbour's plea not to attack that holds the room to an agreement, with no act shown as done, shows only terms (theblackvoid-060 c1359): ONE. (59) A member's reply that tells of the room's past takeover of a neighbour and the help and agreement that followed shows the order in its words, whoever made the call above it (touhou-028 c0028, under c0238, whose writer addresses the room as yall): O-H, as reading 35. (60) Being supposed to work with the target, or working with it, names no agreement, as reading 17 (ubc-052 c0066): NT; yogscast-059 c0011 says the same after a retraction whose call has no code, so it shows neither end: ONE. (61) The target's report that it is making an alliance with the room, given as the reason its logo will not be taken, is talk between the rooms about each other's work (ucf-056 c0075): DEAL; a proposal inside the room to ally stays NT (reading 37). (62) A visitor's call answered by restraint and a rule proposed inside the room, not by terms, is counted as not the room's attack, NA, not V (tampabaylightning-051, a call from a r/kanye member). The same writer's call in rocketleague-060 carries that room's rank flair, so it is the room's call and that row stands. (63) Terms offered in an earlier thread before the first attack call make the bound's pattern (unitedkingdom-045: c0003 at h+16.70, before c0122's raid at h+21.76): BOUND. (64) A member's mourning of a border the other room promised is a breach complaint (uoft-057 c0167): OTHER; a member's proposal that the room ought to have a truce, or should agree with the target, with no request made, is NT (utaustin-063 c0052; turkey-063 c0125). (65) A request for permission reported made is terms, as reading 11 (warriors-052 c0131): DEAL. (66) An edit in the acting post that reports negotiations, or a plan sent to the neighbour, shows the order in the post's words, as reading 9 (warthunder-067 c0065; xenoblade_chronicles-056 c0027, after c0026 keeps writing over the neighbour that c0025 names): O-H. (67) A threat to destroy the target's work if it keeps sabotaging the room is the room's attack plan (uofm-039 c0108), answered in the chain by the target's offer that each side stay off the other's work (c0111): O-A, DEAL. Also: texas-048, thebluecorner-036 and uwaterloo-063 ONE; texastech-030 and thesimpsons-057 O-A, DEAL, the target's offers; trees-060, uiuc-050, weezer-059 and winnipegjets-057 O-A, INV. Draws in this window: taiwan-056 NT, theitalyplace-060 NT, torontoraptors-065 AFTER, ukraine-044 O-A. The ten draws of the second packet: O-A 4 (poland-045, redvsblue-051, stlouis-057, survivor-045, and ukraine-044 makes 5), O-H 1 (rit-060), NT 2 (taiwan-056, theitalyplace-060), ONE 1 (placecanada-058), AFTER 1 (torontoraptors-065).
